nodes.label: Pane conversation search
nodes.description: Search and navigate the conversation currently bound to a selected pane.
nodes.ai_instructions: Do not combine this control with global pane metadata filtering.

nodes.label: Fingerprint-verified API
nodes.description: Validates the live Herdr occupant before search or context lookup.
nodes.ai_instructions: Accept session, pane, expected fingerprint, and search options; never accept a transcript path.

nodes.label: Transcript adapters
nodes.description: Claude, Codex, and AGY adapters emit the same NormalizedMessage contract.
nodes.ai_instructions: Fail closed on unknown formats and exclude system, tool, and reasoning content.

nodes.label: Append-aware LRU cache
nodes.description: Caches normalized messages and ingests appended JSONL bytes.
nodes.ai_instructions: Bind cursors to transcript revisions and cap entry count.

nodes.label: Native transcripts
nodes.description: Read-only Claude JSONL, Codex rollout JSONL, and concise AGY transcript JSONL.
nodes.ai_instructions: Resolve only from fixed provider roots using the verified conversation UUID.

nodes.label: Global FTS index
nodes.ai_instructions: Do not introduce this dependency in Phase 1.

edges.payload: NormalizedMessage[] keyed by provider and conversationId
Fixed provider path(s), byte offsets, stat metadata
